description: Looks up a place name and returns every match, each with its kind, population, English name and coordinate; the official key (AGS/RS) only in the structured result. Use when the person asks where somewhere is, when you need a coordinate for another tool, and above all to RECOVER after a tool reported a name as ambiguous — this is where you find out which Neustadt is which. Pass `near` to rank and separate same-named places by distance. Do NOT use to find a company, shop or landmark: call find_poi. At most 10 results, radius <= 200 km. Every result carries an attribution line to show the user.

kind.description: Narrow to one kind: "city", "district" (Kreis), "admin" (Land or Regierungsbezirk), "station", "stop", "motorway" or "junction". Omit unless the person was specific.

language.description: Set this on every call to the language the person is writing in: "en" if they wrote English, "de" if they wrote German. Do not leave it out: it defaults to German ("de"), which is only the fallback when the language is genuinely unclear, so an English question sent without it is answered in German — a wrong answer. Place names, station names and road numbers are never translated in either language; in English the German term is kept in parentheses so the person recognises it on signs and in local apps.

lat.description: Latitude to measure from, instead of `near`.

limit.description: How many candidates to return, best match first (1–10, default 5).

lon.description: Longitude to measure from, instead of `near`.

near.description: A second place to measure from, used to tell same-named candidates apart: "Neustadt" near "Hamburg" is one of twenty Neustadts. Every result then carries its distance from this point.

query.description: The place name to look up, as the person said it — "Neustadt", "Munich", "Kreis Fulda", "Köln Hbf". English names and spellings without umlauts both work.

radius_km.description: When near/lat+lon is given, keep only candidates within this many kilometres (1–200). Omit to rank by distance without dropping any.

name: find_place
